responsibility: Declares fixed-buffer REAL/string conversion routines for the ISO library. It specifies parsing a character array into a REAL with a ConvResults status and formatting REAL values back into caller-supplied arrays in floating, engineering, fixed, or adaptive forms, providing the array-based counterpart to the DynamicStrings-oriented conversion helpers.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public interface for the RealStr module: it declares the ConvResults alias and the StrToReal/RealTo* procedures but contains no conversion logic. It differs from RealStr.mod, which implements those declared routines using RealConv, ConvStringReal, and DynamicStrings helpers.
